chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam ibn Suhayl narrated to me from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik, who said: Muhammad ibn 'Imran narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Al-Husayn Al-Lu'lu'i narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Muhammad ibn Ayyub, from Al-Harith ibn Mughira Al-Nasri, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and the Exalted, has assigned angels to be in charge of the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him). So when a man intends to visit him and performs Ghusl, Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) will call out, 'O guests of Allah! Rejoice, for you will accompany me in Paradise.' And he mentioned the hadith.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the spiritual hierarchy of the grave of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), where the Prophet Muhammad (s) personally greets pilgrims after their ritual purification (Ghusl). It underscores the Shia belief in the intercessory status of the Ahl al-Bayt and the tangible spiritual connection between the living pilgrim and the Prophet in the afterlife, promising companionship in Paradise as a reward for devotion.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. Muḥammad ibn Hammām ibn Suhayl narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muḥammad ibn Mālik, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Imrān, from Ḥasan ibn Ḥusain Al-Lu`lu`i, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from Muḥammad ibn Ayyūb, from Ḥārith ibn Mughīrah Al-Nasri, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: Allāh, the Blessed and the Exalted, has dedicated some angels to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). When someone decides to go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) and performs Ghusl, Muḥammad (s.a.a.w.) will call out to him, “O guest of Allāh! Be delighted for you will join me in Paradise.”
